standard.summary: Easy Control 是最简单的图像条件训练方案——直接将控制图像（如边缘图、深度图）作为额外通道拼接到输入图像上。
standard.effect: easy_control_scale 控制条件图像的强度。easy_control_channels 控制条件图像的通道数（默认 3）。control_image_dir 指定条件图像目录。control_suffix 指定条件图像的文件名后缀。
standard.whenToUse: 想快速实现简单的图像条件控制时。不需要额外模型（如 ControlNet）。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要精确控制时。简单拼接方式的控制力有限。

standard_en.summary: Easy Control is the simplest image-conditioning scheme -- the control image (an edge map, a depth map) is concatenated onto the input image as extra channels.
standard_en.effect: easy_control_scale sets the condition image's strength. easy_control_channels sets its channel count (3 by default). control_image_dir names the condition image directory. control_suffix names the filename suffix of the condition images.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want simple image conditioning quickly, with no extra model such as ControlNet.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need precise control -- plain concatenation only goes so far.

advanced.principle: 将条件图像（如 Canny 边缘图）缩放到与训练图像相同分辨率，然后作为额外通道拼接到输入图像上。UNet 的第一个卷积层会自动扩展以接收额外通道。easy_control_channels=3 时输入从 4 通道扩展到 7 通道。这种方式不需要额外的 ControlNet 模型，但控制力弱于专门的 ControlNet。
advanced.intervention: DataLoader 中读取条件图像 → 缩放到训练分辨率 → 拼接到输入图像通道上。
advanced.expectedImpact: 实现基本的图像条件控制。文件增量约等于输入通道的扩展。
advanced.tradeoffs: ip_adapter_enabled 提供更丰富的图像条件控制。
advanced.codePath: dataset/elements.py:easy_control → read control image → concat to input channels

advanced_en.principle: Scales the conditioning image (e.g. a Canny edge map) to the training image's resolution, then concatenates it as extra channels onto the input image. The UNet's first conv layer auto-expands to accept the extra channels. With easy_control_channels=3, input grows from 4 to 7 channels. No separate ControlNet model needed, but control is weaker than a dedicated ControlNet.
advanced_en.intervention: DataLoader reads the conditioning image → scales to training resolution → concatenates onto input channels.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Basic image-conditioned control. File-size growth roughly equals the input-channel expansion.
advanced_en.codePath: dataset/elements.py:easy_control → read control image → concat to input channels
